old_problem: The historical review stated that Partial Add assembly was target-specific and undefined. IPMI 2.0 section 33.14 actually defines the state machine: Reserve first, initial Record ID 0000h and offset 0, one returned RID used by continuation requests, strictly sequential non-overlapping offsets, low-nibble in-progress values 0 for intermediate and 1 for the final fragment, discard on reservation cancellation before completion, optional 80h length-mismatch rejection, and invisibility until complete. What remains Project-specific is the approved record and safe fragment plan, which can be parameterized. As with Add SDR, there is no generic SDR-record checksum to invent.
disposition_reason: Split one absent, owner-approved disposable SDR into at least two fixed fragments, start at offset 0 with Record ID 0000h, retain the first successful response RID for all continuations, advance each offset by the exact preceding data length without gaps/overlap, keep reserved bits zero, and mark only the final fragment 01h. Use a stable reservation for a non-modal transaction or the explicitly supported 0000h modal path, and stop on any completion/RID/offset ambiguity. After the final commit, use a fresh reservation to reconstruct the entire record and validate its monitoring footprint, then delete only the returned key/ID and reconcile canonical repository content. An incomplete non-modal transaction is aborted by canceling its reservation once; an ambiguous final must be searched by unique key before recovery. Never restart automatically, use ordinary Add as evidence, invent fragment semantics, or clear/reset the repository.
decision_basis: Master XLSX rows 1081-1086, exact same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT second review, tests_gpt_merged, selection manifest and historical V3.1 record were directly read. tests.json contains one occurrence of this code. The related OOB Partial Add is row 1212 / variant e26a80a8e8844739 and remains separate. Formal queue sequence 76 was independently verified as row 1086 / variant c22f8821037fd741.

IPMI v2.0 Appendix G assigns Partial Add SDR to Storage NetFn 0Ah/Cmd 25h. Table 33-2 requires Partial Add for a writable repository when ordinary Add is not provided and exposes support in Get SDR Repository Info operation-support bit 2.

Section 33.14 requires Reserve SDR Repository before a non-modal partial add. Request bytes are Reservation ID LS/MS, continuation Record ID LS/MS, offset, in-progress field and fragment data; the first request uses Record ID 0000h and offset 00h.

Fragments must be sequential with no gap or overlap. Intermediate requests use in-progress low nibble 0h, the last uses 1h, and high-nibble reserved bits remain zero. The response returns a two-byte RID that anchors all continuation fragments.

The assembled record is not retrievable until the final fragment completes. If the reservation is canceled earlier, the incomplete information is discarded and a new attempt would have to restart at offset 0; ED-38 means this testcase records failure and does not restart automatically.

Completion 80h may report that the final byte count does not match the header Record-Length, although that check is optional for the controller. Independent validation must always require concatenated fragment length=5+Record-Length and full post-commit readback.

Section 43 supplies the five-byte Record ID/version/type/length header, key and body formats. It does not define a general record checksum. Any checksum inside OEM data requires the OEM owner's schema; otherwise the parser validates header length and all standard/OEM fields without inventing one.

In SDR Repository Update Mode the request still carries reservation bytes but uses 0000h and reservation is not required. The standard does not fully specify abort cleanup for an incomplete modal partial add, so modal execution additionally requires an authoritative platform abort/Exit contract; otherwise that target is NOT READY.

An intermediate response ambiguity cannot be resolved by resending the same offset. For a non-modal sequence, cancel the reservation once to discard incomplete state and prove the unique key absent. For a possibly committed final fragment, enumerate by key before any delete or future test.

After final commit the add can invalidate reservations. Full 23h readback and targeted 26h deletion therefore use newly obtained reservations, and the final repository is compared by stable record key/body rather than volatile IDs/timestamps.

ED-02 preserves identity; ED-03 protects OEM semantics; ED-13/ED-15 govern N/A and exact criteria; ED-17 preserves evidence; ED-19 separates IB/OOB; ED-28/ED-30 require abort/recovery; ED-34 parameterizes record/fragments; ED-38 prohibits retry.

test_case.test_name: IPMI Partial Add SDR (IB Storage 0Ah/25h) reserved sequential assembly, final commit and targeted cleanup
test_case.purpose: Exercise the in-band Partial Add SDR transaction itself with at least two ordered fragments of one approved disposable record, prove reservation/RID/offset/finalization behavior and exact assembled readback, then remove only the committed record without using ordinary Add, OOB evidence, broad clear or automatic restart.
required_package: Approved BMC/firmware/local interface with writable repository, Partial Add support, targeted Delete support, and authoritative non-modal reservation behavior or modal 0000h plus explicit incomplete-transaction abort/Exit behavior

Version-controlled complete APPROVED_SDR_BYTES with repository-approved Record-ID placeholder, valid version/type/Record-Length and unique key/body; registered IANA/owner schema for OEM bytes and no invented generic checksum

A fixed FRAGMENT_PLAN of at least two nonempty chunks whose concatenation exactly equals APPROVED_SDR_BYTES, first offset 0, every next offset equal to cumulative bytes, request sizes within transport limits, only the last in-progress value 01h
Immutable repository and monitoring baseline, capacity/allocation/mode proof, unique-key absence, inert/approved effect oracle, maintenance window and explicit confirmation
Per-fragment raw evidence recorder; fresh-reservation chunked 23h reader; targeted 26h cleanup; non-modal reservation-cancel abort and, for modal mode, vendor-approved incomplete-assembly recovery
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED STATEFUL SDR PROCEDURE; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Record Source Key/variant/target; export and canonicalize the repository by type/key/body; capture 0Ah/20h info/allocation/mode; prove the approved unique key absent, capacity sufficient and every record byte authoritative. Validate total bytes=5+Record-Length, FRAGMENT_COUNT>=2, concatenation exact, first chunk includes the approved header, offsets [0,cumulative lengths], transport fit and expected monitoring effect; do not invent a checksum. For non-modal mode obtain one 0Ah/22h RESERVATION; for modal mode enter 2Ah once and use reservation 0000h only with approved abort/Exit recovery. Display all fragment hashes, offsets, flags and cleanup for immediate approval. Send fragment 0 once as 0Ah/25h `[Rlo Rhi 00 00 00 00 DATA0]`; require completion 00h and valid RID. For each non-final continuation send once `[Rlo Rhi RIDlo RIDhi OFFSET 00 DATAi]`; for the final fragment only use `[Rlo Rhi RIDlo RIDhi OFFSET 01 DATAfinal]`. Require every completion 00h and identical RID, never read partial contents or resend an offset. After final commit, acquire a fresh reservation, reconstruct RID using bounded 0Ah/23h reads, and require assigned RID in the header plus exact equality of all other bytes and approved monitoring effect. Exit modal mode once if entered. Acquire another fresh reservation, revalidate the stable key at RID, issue one exact 0Ah/26h delete, prove key absence, and reconcile count/capacity/overflow and the baseline canonical multiset. Keep ordinary 24h Add, 27h clear, initialization, reset and row-1212 OOB outside this coverage.
test_case.expected_result: Every authorized 25h fragment completes 00h, returns the same valid RID and follows the exact offset/flag plan; no record is visible before the final fragment. The final fragment commits exactly one record, fresh-reservation 23h reconstruction matches the approved assembled bytes with repository-assigned RID, and only the approved monitoring footprint occurs. Exact-key 26h cleanup removes that RID and restores the canonical repository/monitoring baseline with overflow clear, allowing expected volatile IDs/timestamps to differ. A pre-final canceled non-modal reservation leaves no unique key. Any mismatch, ambiguity, visible incomplete record, unintended effect or incomplete cleanup is FAIL/NOT READY without restart.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact IB identity, authoritative 25h/mode/abort/Delete support, an approved complete record, at least two exact fragments, correct reservation/RID/offset/flag progression, per-fragment completion, one final commit, complete 23h equality, expected monitoring behavior, targeted removal and canonical recovery. FAIL covers guessed fragments/OEM data/checksum, one-fragment pseudo-test, gap/overlap/repeated offset, changing RID, nonzero reserved bits, early 01h, final length mismatch, partial visibility, unexpected sensor/control effects, ordinary Add/OOB substitution, clear/reset, automatic restart or failed recovery. NOT READY covers absent fixture, capacity, fragment plan, mode/abort contract, unique key, Delete path, containment or approval. N/A requires authoritative absence of Partial Add support, not one command error.
safety_gate: Use one absent, owner-approved disposable record and a frozen multi-fragment plan. Do not derive chunks while executing, mutate the fixture between requests or guess any standard/OEM byte.

Hold one reservation for the entire non-modal partial transaction; do not call Reserve again until abort or post-final readback. In modal mode, use 0000h only with an explicit platform abort/Exit contract.
Send every offset once, in order, with high reserved bits zero and 01h only on the final fragment. Any ambiguous response stops the sequence; never resend or automatically restart at offset 0.

On a non-final non-modal failure, cancel the reservation once to discard incomplete data and verify the key absent. On an ambiguous final, enumerate once by stable key because the record may already be committed.
After commit, treat RID as volatile, acquire fresh reservations and recheck key/body immediately before exact deletion. Reconcile content by key/body because other Record IDs may change.

Never clear the repository or logs, invoke ordinary Add/initialization/reset, or substitute OOB. If modal exit, key identity or cleanup is uncertain, preserve all fragments and repository evidence and escalate.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant; BMC/firmware/local-interface identity; official 25h state-machine authority; separate ordinary Add and row-1212 OOB identities
Immutable raw/decoded repository baseline, canonical key/body multiset, capacity/allocation/mode and reservation or modal-abort authority, plus unique-key absence
Approved record source/hash and decoded header/key/body, Record-Length calculation, OEM owner if applicable, fixed fragment table with offset/length/in-progress/hash and explicit confirmation
Per-fragment exact request, timestamp, completion and returned RID showing one stable sequence and no resend
Fresh-reservation complete 23h reconstruction, exact assembled comparison, repository info change and monitoring/alert/control effect

Abort evidence for a pre-final failure or exact-key 26h cleanup after commit, final canonical repository/monitoring reconciliation and PASS/FAIL/NOT READY/N/A; record that the review agent executed nothing on a DUT
test_case.recovery: For a definitely non-final failed or ambiguous non-modal request, do not continue or resend: acquire one new reservation to cancel the transaction, then verify the unique key is absent and preserve per-fragment evidence. A modal transaction requires its preapproved firmware-specific abort plus one Exit 2Bh; absent that contract, do not start. If the final response is ambiguous, exit mode if applicable and enumerate once by stable key. Zero matches means no delete; exactly one match is deleted once after a fresh reservation and key/body recheck; multiple or mismatched records require owner escalation. Never restart automatically, clear/repopulate, reset, or guess a continuation.

source_conflict.reason: Section 33.14 resolves reservation, RID, offset, sequencing, finalization, discard and response semantics. The review layer supplies an approved complete record and fixed fragment plan while removing log clearing and the erroneous generic-checksum assumption.

blocked.reason: The core multi-fragment state machine and non-modal abort are standardized. Record bytes, split plan, mode-specific recovery, capacity and effect oracle are enforceable Project prerequisites; unsafe modal targets remain NOT READY without inventing behavior.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Exact BMC/firmware; Partial Add/Delete and modal/non-modal support; complete approved record; fixed multi-fragment offsets/flags; capacity/transport limits; unique key and effect oracle; reservation-cancel or modal abort/Exit recovery; monitoring window and explicit approval.

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1 E7
external_authorities.application: Sections 33.2, 33.7, 33.11-33.15 and 43 plus Appendix G define Storage 0Ah/Cmd25h, reservation/modal behavior, initial and continuation RID, exact offset/in-progress state machine, discard before completion, final length error, complete 23h readback and 26h cleanup.

project_authority: The SDR/BMC owner binds repository mode and abort semantics, the exact compatible record and OEM authority, fixed multi-fragment plan, capacity/transport limits, monitoring effect, approval and targeted cleanup. It cannot replace 25h with 24h/OOB, invent a checksum, accept a one-fragment pseudo-test, resend ambiguous fragments, ignore stable-key checks or recover by clear/reset.
